caption: The drawing depicts a brown wooden tobacco pipe with a black mouthpiece, situated in the center of the page. The bowl of the pipe has black writing on it, partially legible with letters and words such as "DERNESS" and "May 5th and 6th." To the upper right and lower left of the pipe’s bowl are two fragmented, partial bowls of similar color and design, with each piece also bearing black lettering or script. The background is an off-white or light beige color, showing some smudges and discoloration, particularly along the top and right edges. The arrangement has the main intact pipe diagonally oriented from lower left to upper right, while the fragmented pieces float separately near the top right and bottom left corners of the drawing.
title: Pipe
